affected_system: rights-preserving compliance assistance, incentives, inspections, and enforcement
alternatives: activate a bounded reserve from forecast risk bands for compliance assistance and inspection workload
use rolling forecasts and conservative capacity triggers for compliance assistance and inspection workload
pair deadline, policy, channel, case-mix, and season forecasting with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Eligibility, notice, awareness, capability, action, inspection, violation, sanction, and outcome remain distinct.
No behavioral score automatically triggers enforcement, benefit denial, or coercive action.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: continue ordinary capacity planning for compliance assistance and inspection workload.

constraints.description: The compliance, incentives, and behavioral policy forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: regulatory operations director and behavioral insights lead
decision_question: What rule, group, channel, season, and deadline-specific workload should operations prepare for?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The compliance, incentives, and behavioral policy forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for compliance assistance and inspection workload passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: deadline, policy, channel, case-mix, and season forecasting
independence_key.primary_outcome: priority assistance and inspection demand above capacity

intended_claim: A versioned forecast design for comparing declared alternatives affecting compliance assistance and inspection workload, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: priority assistance and inspection demand above capacity
distributional gap in priority assistance and inspection demand above capacity
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not call forecast cases violations, intentional behavior, or enforcement outcomes.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for compliance assistance and inspection workload passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.

title: Forecast compliance assistance and inspection demand
transportability_risks: Law, administrative burden, trust, incentives, capability, enforcement, and baseline behavior differ.
Observed compliance may reflect detection and documentation rather than underlying behavior.
